title: P6-03: Pilobol.us: Google sign-in on the new Cognito domain (same Google client), secrets in production, first admin
description:
## Goal
The real Pilobol.us content is copied from the legacy backend to the new one with a proven fidelity, and the NEW reader app builds from the NEW backend and is byte-identical to the live reader.

## Context (FACT, read-only 2026-10-10)
- Source: stack amplify-dv0pdx67fk80m-main-branch-0f2f45caa3 (AppSync sqbda7ammrcurjmog54uo4wmky, pool us-east-1_vyTCcLVQK). Non-zero tables: Item 21, PublishedItem 18, MediaAsset 13, PublishedMediaAsset 12, ModelAttachment 2, Message 2, MessageThread 1 (all other tables 0; identity tables hold 1 admin who is not copied).
- Source media bucket amplify-dv0pdx67fk80m-mai-papyrusmediabucket0dab24-onja3prevkp2: 112 objects, 20,466,255 bytes: media/ 13, newsroom/ 2, preview/ 97 (staging preview payloads, regenerated by staging builds: do not copy).
- Tool: `papyrus ops content copy-backend` with per-side credentials (papyrus-newsroom next.35 or newer; docs/migrations/copy-backend.md): `--source-outputs stack:amplify-dv0pdx67fk80m-main-branch-0f2f45caa3 --target-outputs stack:<new backend stack> --source-profile legacy --target-profile papyrus-production --expect-source-account 335163751677 --expect-target-account 712236451410 --models Item,PublishedItem,MediaAsset,PublishedMediaAsset,ModelAttachment --s3-prefixes media/,newsroom/ --s3-transfer stream`. Message and MessageThread (3 rows) are skipped unless Ryan wants them. Lessons from PPY-e20cab: composite sort-key defaults are handled from dev38; the prefix selector normalizes to a trailing slash.
- The reader (markus-static) exports published items at build time as a guest. Its env var NAMES are PAPYRUS_GRAPHQL_ENDPOINT, PAPYRUS_IDENTITY_POOL_ID, PAPYRUS_MEDIA_BUCKET (plus PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND, SITE_ENV). The new reader app must carry the NEW backend's values; if it still pointed at the legacy backend it would build the right bytes from the wrong data and nobody would notice.

## Exact steps
1. Dry run (no writes): per-model created/updated/unchanged equal the counts above, 0 invalid, S3 missing = 15 objects (media 13, newsroom 2). Review with Ryan.
2. Ryan yes, apply with the editing freeze announced for the legacy newsroom; second run must report 0 create, 0 update, 0 copy.
3. Fidelity: counts per model; per-row content manifests (sha256, excluding createdAt, updatedAt, owner and identity fields) id by id; S3 key, size and ETag manifests equal for the 15 objects; byte-compare all 13 media files.
4. Set the NEW reader app's branch env vars to the new backend's endpoint, identity pool id and media bucket; assert the values equal the new stack outputs (compare, do not print); turn reader auto-build on; build main.
5. Parity: crawl the new reader default URL main.<newReaderId>.amplifyapp.com against the P6-01 baseline of https://pilobol.us: same status, content-type, cache-control and sha256 on every path (canonical, og:url and sitemap already say https://pilobol.us); 404 page body equals the old 404 body.
6. Rebuild-on-publish proof: Ryan publishes and unpublishes a draft in the new CMS; the new reader starts a job (not the legacy reader), the page appears and disappears; revert so the corpus equals the baseline again.

## Acceptance checks
- All of the above; legacy row counts and S3 object count/bytes unchanged before and after (source read-only); no value printed.

## Rollback
Delete the copied rows/objects or the new stack (Ryan); the tool never deletes; the legacy backend is untouched.

## Risks
SSO expiry mid-run (idempotent re-run); writes to the legacy newsroom during the window (delta at cutover); Auritus narration depends on verbatim text (the copy preserves bodies and ids).

## Needs Ryan
Dry-run review, apply yes, freeze, whether to copy Message/MessageThread, the publish/unpublish click.

## Common rules (Phase 6, PPY-7d8cd0)
- Read ~/Projects/Papyrus/AGENTS.local.md first. Assert the account with `aws sts get-caller-identity --query Account --output text` before EVERY call: profile legacy = 335163751677, profile papyrus-production = 712236451410. Never use papyrus-development; papyrus-staging (494166748521) is not used by this phase.
- Every write needs Ryan's explicit yes in chat for that step. Legacy is READ-ONLY except the steps this ticket names (each with a yes). No SCPs on legacy; never risk legacy access; no `cdk deploy` and no `ampx` against the legacy stacks of these sites.
- Never print secret values (names only; SSM values move by pipe, never to the terminal or a ticket). Ryan deletes retired resources. Do not touch Anth.us production d2hbn1ig6nqyhy or the other anth.us apps (apricity d2n7w4kwqyfwn4, babulus d3epcqvzbxdaq, tactus dfkbdffs2viq8, primus divicqm3nhcwt).
- Baselines and scratch live under ~/Projects/.baselines/phase6-<date>/ (outside any repo); clones go under ~/Projects/ and are deleted afterwards (disk is tight). Only kbs writes in the Papyrus checkout (never git add/commit there); never `git stash`.
- The committed infra/site.json in each site repo still describes the LEGACY stack until the cutover ticket; production deploys use an out-of-repo, domain-free copy (as PPY-aa93b3 did for p.apyr.us).
right_now_summary: Production secrets and the first admin still need setup for Google sign-in on the new Cognito domain.
